recentItems.title: Kylie Jenner Shows Off Her "Dream" Home After 6 Years of Construction | E! News
recentItems.description:
Kylie Jenner is in the home stretch. The 'Kardashians' star gave a look inside the mega mansion she's been building for the past six years in Hidden Hills, Calif., posing a YouTube video with a full tour of the Italy-inspired space that sits on five acres of land she reportedly bought for $15 million in 2020. "My beautiful dream Italian home," Kylie shared in the Sept. 6 vlog. "Feel like I've been working on this for so long and I'm just ready for it to be done and to move in." Starting with the exterior, the 29-year-old gave a look at the property's reclaimed cobblestone driveway and Mediterranean landscaping by Jim Hyatt, who also worked on the famed San Ysidro Ranch in Santa Barbara.  "So, we kind of copied what he did for them," she explained. "It's lavender, which will grow in way more by the time I move in. And these old ancient olives for the entry, which I'm obsessed with." Inside the main living space, Kylie—who shares daughter Stormi, 8, and son Aire, 4, with ex Travis Scott—showed off her reclaimed wood floors, an old fireplace that will be installed and stone floors in her gigantic kitchen. As for the backyard, Kylie is constructing an outdoor dining space under two large olive trees, complete with a pizza oven and fountain, explaining, "I wanted somewhere to go to throw dinner parties and birthdays." Her California yard also includes more baby olive trees that she rescued from Kendall Jenner's nearby mansion. "My sister was doing some construction at one of her homes," Kylie said. "And she had to get rid of all of these baby olives, and she was like, 'Does anyone want them?' And I said, 'Absolutely.'" She noted, "Not only are they so beautiful, [but] it reminds me of my sister every time I look at them." The grounds of her home also feature a cement court to play different sports, and she has plans to add a rose garden outside. As Kylie put it, "'Cause I just want to be a princess."

recentItems.title: Inside Maria Bartiromo's Marriage With Husband Jonathan Steinberg | E! News
recentItems.description:
Maria Bartiromo's marriage to Jonathan Steinberg has been going strong for nearly thirty years. The former Fox News and Fox Business anchor recently made headlines for her abrupt departure from the network. In the chaotic aftermath of the announcement, we're taking a closer look at her decades-long marriage to her financier husband. Long before she became a Fox News mainstay, Bartiromo met Steinberg—who is the son of late billionaire financier Saul Steinberg—in 1990, just after her college graduation. The two tied the knot in 1999. Steinberg is also in finance and is the CEO of WisdomTree Investments. Fox Media confirmed Bartiromo's departure in a statement Sept. 3, saying, "Effective today, Maria Bartiromo is no longer with Fox News Media. We thank Maria for her work over the last 12 1/2 year and wish her all the best on her next chapter." President Donald Trump later spoke out on her exit, writing in a Truth Social post, "I can’t believe Maria Bartiromo is no longer going to have her great show(s) on FoxNews/Business. Three different shows, always number one. Maria is a total professional, and a true warrior.” He concluded, "Her fans, of which there are many, will not be happy. God bless you, Maria! President DONALD J. TRUMP." Bartiromo's attorney, Bryan Freedman—who represented Justin Baldoni in his high-profile case against Blake Lively—later denied that Bartiromo was fired and further claimed that she was "still employed by Fox."

recentItems.title: David Harbour Details Working With Millie Bobby Brown Again | E! News
recentItems.description:
For David Harbour, there's nothing strange about working with Millie Bobby Brown. That's why the 'Stranger Things' actor jumped at the chance to reunite with his costar on a new Netflix show, joking that he and Brown "can't get enough" of each other even after playing father and daughter across 10 years. "I go anywhere in the world and people know the relationship of Hopper and Eleven," Harbour exclusively told E! News at the 2026 Creative Arts Emmy Awards on Sept. 6. "There's something about that I thought was so special." Although Stranger Things came to an end in 2025 after five season, the 51-year-old said he still "wanted to use the building blocks of the dynamic between me and her" to explore other stories and "build something that was really unique and original." Harbour continued, "It really is a working relationship, where we love what we bring out in each other. You're in service of a greater story, and we both know how to do that and think about that and talk about that." He added, "I love what we have together and I love to be able to see her on a daily basis." Harbour won his first Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie for his role as Floyd Smernitch in HBO's 'DTF St. Louis.' The 78th Emmy Awards will be held over three nights, on September 5, 6 and 14. The September 14 ceremony, hosted by Emmy winner Mariska Hargitay, will be broadcast live on NBC from the Peacock Theater at L.A. LIVE at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT and will stream live and on demand on Peacock. Nights one and two will be edited into a single broadcast, the 78th Emmy Awards (Creative Arts), airing Saturday, September 12, on FXX at 8 p.m. ET/PT, available to stream on Hulu the next day.
